faqs.a:
(a)
No permit shall be issued for use on a motorcycle, moped or other two-wheel vehicle.
(b)
Except as stated in subsection (a) of this section, on application made to the traffic
               engineer or his designee on forms provided by the city, the traffic engineer or his
               designee shall issue no more than five permits per residence when the address of the
               applicant is within a restricted parking area. The applicant shall on request provide
               a currently valid state drivers license to establish that his residence is within
               the restricted parking area.
(c)
The first two permits are free and a fee of $5.00 shall be charged for each permit
               thereafter up to five permits.
(d)
In order to fall within an exception to the parking prohibitions outlined in
section 54-243
, the permit must be displayed in the motor vehicle in the manner described in
section 54-243
.
(Code 1981, § 17-130; Ord. No. 2804, § 1, 4-15-1991; Ord. No. 2996, § 1, 8-16-1993;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
